[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips to maximize closet space, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Purge and declutter: Sort items into keep, donate/sell, and discard piles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Categorize and group: Group similar items together.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Assign a home: Designate specific areas for each category of items.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Use vertical space: Utilize stackable shelves or multi-level hanging rods.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Invest in storage containers: Use bins, baskets, or drawers for smaller items.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Utilize the back of the door: Use over-the-door storage racks or hooks.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Implement a "one in, one out" policy: Get rid of an old item for every new one.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Consider a closet organizer system: Invest in a custom or pre-made system for larger closets.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Keep shoes in order: Store shoes in a designated area.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Maintain your space: Set aside time each week to keep the closet organized.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for seasonal rotation, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Store items thoughtfully: Clean and dry clothes before storing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Label and categorize: Label boxes with contents and seasons.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Choose the right storage containers: Use sturdy, breathable, pest-resistant containers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Store items that can be layered: Keep versatile items accessible.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Consider a "maybe" box: For items you're unsure about keeping.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Schedule a seasonal swap: Set reminders to switch out clothes.
